issues.claim: If the semaphore were created as `new SemaphoreSlim(1)` without a maximum, `Release` would simply raise the count to 2, and from then on the semaphore would silently admit two holders at once.
issues.problem: The excerpts do not show that the single-argument constructor uses `int.MaxValue` as the maximum count. The generator notes say this was recalled from memory and not re-checked. The Release excerpt only says `SemaphoreFullException` is thrown when the maximum size is reached. I believe the claim is true, but the evidence does not confirm it. The same applies to the Russian text.
issues.suggestedFix: Add and check the constructor page (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.threading.semaphoreslim.-ctor) as a third link with a matching `linkTitles` entry in both locales, and confirm that `SemaphoreSlim(Int32)` has no maximum below `Int32.MaxValue`. Otherwise drop the claim.
